ruleset.name: VIP Workflows — incrementally enforced sniffs
ruleset.description: Sniffs enforced file-by-file via the pre-commit hook (.githooks/pre-commit) rather than repo-wide. A touched file is auto-fixed and converges on commit. Once the whole codebase is clean under this ruleset, fold these rules back into .phpcs.xml.dist and delete this file. See .githooks/README.md.
